attributes.board_name: Maryland Board of Social Work Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Category I (min. half): courses, workshops, seminars, symposia, conferences by Board-authorized sponsors; Category II (max. half): peer case conferences, journal clubs, presenting/teaching/authoring (max 12 each), online learning (digital seminar, pre-recorded webinar, online course, home study) by authorized sponsors, in-service training

topics.who: Ethics and professional conduct incl. boundary issues, or Maryland social work standards and laws (Category I or II)
Category I anti-oppressive practice: race, culture or equity (cultural humility, social justice, racial equity, implicit bias, anti-racism)
All health occupations licensees: one-time attestation of an implicit bias course and (HB 782) a structural racism course

rules.notes: Renewal period Nov 1 - Oct 31 (2 years). 1 CEU = 60 minutes. Online/pre-recorded learning counts as Category II.
